head: ac0237f34011d823a856117834a18cf02a64b774
classification: CI harness source-freeze failure before tests
cause: Git core.autocrlf=true emitted CRLF warnings on stderr; merged stdout/stderr polluted the first NUL-separated status field. Generated changes are still only the two permitted registrants.
fix: Set core.autocrlf=false locally in the isolated upstream repository before its first checkout; preserve canonical commit bytes on every OS.
regressionValidation: Reproduced the warning failure with a real temporary Git repository, then local core.autocrlf=false restores exact git-show bytes; 9 guards passed.
